# Costa Franca Tours

> Top-rated tour and excursion agency based in Mazatlán, Sinaloa, México.
> Specialists in maritime boat tours, adventure excursions, and coastal experiences.
> Bilingual service in Spanish and English. Available Monday to Sunday, 8:00 AM – 10:00 PM.
> Contact via WhatsApp: +52 669 152 5822 | Email: contacto@costafrancatours.com

## About

Costa Franca Tours is a Mazatlán-based travel agency offering curated tours and excursions
across the Pacific coast of Sinaloa. All tours include round-trip hotel transportation from
the Golden Zone (Zona Dorada), Malecón, and Cerritos. The agency operates verified local
operators with a focus on safety, quality, and authentic regional experiences.

## Tours

### Stone Island Tour (Paseo Isla de la Piedra)
URL: https://www.costafrancatours.com/tours/isla-piedra
Duration: ~5 hours | From $550 MXN per adult
Catamaran cruise past sea lion colonies and sea caves, followed by 3 hours on Stone Island
beach with open bar and lunch. All-inclusive option adds banana boat and horseback riding.
Departs daily: 10:00 AM, 12:00 PM, 2:00 PM.

### Deer Island Trimaran Tour (Paseo Isla de Venados en Trimarán)
URL: https://www.costafrancatours.com/tours/isla-venados
Duration: 5 hours | From $1,520 MXN per adult
Scenic 1.5-hour trimaran bay cruise to Deer Island nature reserve. Includes 3.5 hours on
the island with snorkeling, kayaking, banana boat ride, open bar, and lunch.
Departs daily: 9:30 AM.

### Veranos ATV Adventure (Aventura en Cuatrimotos por Veranos)
URL: https://www.costafrancatours.com/tours/cuatrimotos-veranos
Duration: ~4 hours | From $2,400 MXN per adult
Off-road ATV ride through rural Sinaloa, crossing a suspension bridge and visiting local
villages. Includes traditional ranch lunch and artisanal tequila distillery tour with tasting.
Departs daily: 9:00 AM.

### Sensation Catamaran: Sinaloense Band Party (Fiesta con Banda Sinaloense)
URL: https://www.costafrancatours.com/tours/catamaran-sensation
Duration: 3 hours | From $1,000 MXN per adult
Luxury 2-story catamaran sunset cruise with live Sinaloense brass band, premium open bar,
and taco bar on board. Two-deck layout: lower deck tables, upper deck dance floor.
Departs Wed, Fri, Sat, Sun: 4:00 PM. Saturdays: guests 12+ only.

### Speed Boat Adventure (Aventura en Speed Boat)
URL: https://www.costafrancatours.com/tours/speed-boats
Duration: 2 hours | From $2,800 MXN per boat
Self-driven speedboat tour across Mazatlán Bay. Panoramic route past the Three Islands
with expert guide commentary. Sea lion sightings available in winter season. Minimum age: 8.
Departs daily: 9:00 AM, 11:00 AM.
